summary: Enhance your skills in monitoring and evaluation for agricultural development projects. Join our comprehensive course and drive impactful change in farming.
lede: M&E for Agricultural Development Projects equips professionals to track, assess, and report outcomes from farming and food security interventions. You will learn to develop Theories of Change and Logical Frameworks, define agricultural indicators, measure crop yield and livelihood resilience, and turn field data into credible reports. The training covers mobile data collection with KoboToolbox, offline-first approaches for low-connectivity areas, GIS mapping, Food Insecurity Experience Scale calculations, Indicator Tracking Tables, and data visualisation dashboards. Through practical work on LogFrames, survey instruments, and reporting systems, you will align field metrics with donor requirements and produce evidence that can withstand audit and stakeholder scrutiny.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, or overseeing monitoring and evaluation systems within rural development and food security contexts.
modules: Foundations of Agricultural M&E and Results-Based Management
Designing the Logical Framework for Agriculture
Standardized Indicators for Food Security and Livelihoods
Digital Data Collection and Mobile Survey Design
Spatial Analysis and GIS for Agricultural M&E
Data Quality Assurance and Field Monitoring
Impact Evaluation Designs for Rural Development
Data Visualization, Reporting, and Adaptive Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management principles and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. No prior coding or advanced statistical software experience is required. Familiarity with agricultural, rural development, or food security contexts is highly recommended. Participants must bring a laptop for the digital data collection and GIS mapping exercises.
